mutants.description: Power-good LED is also lit for the whole of S_RUN, on the belief that the supervisor only reaches S_RUN once the rail is in regulation, instead of following the comparator alone
mutants.reason: With run_active high and pgood low (the rail drops out of regulation while the converter is in S_RUN), pgood_LED stays lit instead of going dark on the next clock.

mutants.description: Outstanding strikes are shown solid while the converter is not switching (hiccup off-time, S_OFF) and blink only during the retry and run, so Red_LED1 looks like a latched trip during every hiccup
mutants.reason: With strike_level non-zero, no latch, and ss_active and run_active both low (S_HICCUP), Red_LED1 stays solidly lit instead of following the blink square wave.
